about_the_game:
Meet Maddox Holloway, a young 9 years old boy in rural England, 1940. With his father gone to the front lines in the midst of World War II, a dark affliction begins to consume his mother. Day by day, she transforms into a horrible and despicable creature. "Mutter" is the story of Maddox's struggle, a harrowing journey through suffering, fear, mental illness and a desperate forced sense of responsibility. You must confront the monster she is becoming while clinging to the memory of who she once was.

Explore a hauntingly beautiful world brought to life with a unique, handcrafted stop-motion aesthetic. Navigate the anxieties of a child forced to grow up too soon as you solve puzzles, explore the English countryside, and piece together the tragic mystery behind your family's curse. This is not just a story of survival, but a poignant and unsettling tale about the enduring, and sometimes terrifying, bonds of family and the horrors of war.

  • A Stop-Motion World: Immerse yourself in a visually captivating story inspired by classic STOP-MOTION and CLAYMATION movies aesthetics. Every scenary and character is crafted to give that unique and haunting stop-motion vibe/experience.

  • An Emotionally Resonant Narrative: Experience a powerful and unsettling story of childhood trauma, grief, and dysfunctional family dynamics. Delve into a psychological horror that explores deeper themes beyond simple jump scares for a lasting impact.

  • Adventure & Puzzle Gameplay: Solve interactive environmental puzzles, balance mechanics, and use your wits to overcome obstacles and progress through the story.

  • Explore the English Countryside: Utilize your bicycle to traverse the interconnected world, accessing new areas and finding moments of respite from the encroaching darkness.

  • Tend to Your Garden, Survive the Nightmare: Engage in gardening and resource gathering. Collect vegetables and plants from around the world, which will be essential for crafting recipes and items crucial to your survival and progression of the story.

  • Original Haunting Soundtrack: A beautifully eerie and original musical score made in-house to accompany your journey, to immerse you into the atmosphere of wonder and dread.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Additional Notes: Low 1080p @ 60 FPS

  • OS: Windows 11

  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2080, 8 GB or AMD RX 6800
  • Additional Notes: High 1080p @ 60 FPS

short_description: In the midst of war, a far more personal horror takes root at home. Your mother is becoming a monster. Survive, uncover the truth, and navigate a heartbreaking bond in this unique stop-motion narrative horror adventure.
